_description: Hand-repaired Bible Crampon (NEO) verses. These 36 arrived from the USFM source with an inline footnote whose closing '*' was lost, so the mechanical rule in clean-bible-text.mjs cannot find where the note ends and scripture resumes. Each entry below is the verse with the footnote apparatus removed and nothing else changed; the surviving words are exactly the source's, never supplied. Applied by scripts/apply-neo-footnote-patch.mjs.
_source: Bible Crampon 1923, as carried in data/gutenberg/chapters
